# BSetup UAE
> Your expert partner for company formation and corporate services in the United Arab Emirates. We provide clear, efficient, and reliable solutions for entrepreneurs and businesses looking to establish a presence in Dubai, Abu Dhabi, and across the UAE.

## Core Business Setup Services
- [UAE Mainland Company Setup](https://businesssetupuae.ae/uae-mainland-company-setup): For businesses seeking unrestricted access to the local UAE market and the ability to work with government entities.
- [UAE Free Zone Company Setup](https://businesssetupuae.ae/uae-free-zones): The ideal choice for international trade, offering 100% foreign ownership, zero taxes, and full profit repatriation.
- [Offshore Company Formation](https://businesssetupuae.ae/services/offshore-company-formation): A strategic tool for international trade, asset protection, and tax planning with complete confidentiality.

## Key Support Services
- [PRO Services](https://businesssetupuae.ae/services/pro-services-uae): Comprehensive government liaison services, including visa processing, document clearing, and license renewals.
- [Corporate Bank Account Opening](https://businesssetupuae.ae/services/corporate-bank-account-opening): Expert assistance in navigating the complexities of opening a business bank account in the UAE.
- [UAE Visa Services](https://businesssetupuae.ae/uae-residence-visas): Full support for investor visas, employment visas, dependent visas, and the UAE Golden Visa.
